$comment: The advisories bun audit may report without failing, one entry per (bun advisory, package) (tools/audit/audit.ts). Reviewed 2026-11-16 against release c9473b82. runtimeIn is every workspace that loads the package at runtime: each dependency on the path is a dependency, an optional dependency or a required peer, never a dev dependency or an optional peer. inInferOpsInstance says whether the API-only instance InferOps runs (api and its workspace packages; ADR 0023 O10 in factory-level/inferops) loads it. A reported entry not listed, a severity that differs from bun's, or (in CI) a listed entry bun no longer reports fails the audit.

advisories.title: better-auth: OAuth state can be used as a Magic Link to sign in as another user
advisories.reason: The auth library the API runs (api, @crm/auth); its SSO plugin is always mounted. The one an API-only instance depends on most: tracked for upgrade to 1.7.7 or later, recommended first.
